registryEvidence.custodian: Board of Revenue, Government of Sindh; Sindh Zameen / LARMIS public land-record portal; Umerkot taluka revenue office context

boundedResponse.responseSummary: HTTP JSON response returned Available Dehs:0 for this route/parameter combination; no parcel ID or geometry was returned.

parcelDiscovery.note: No parcel polygon, native identifier, schema, or CRS was obtained. The exact WUP point was preserved and was not used as an absence test. No source-specific attribute set is retained.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: HTTP 200; current official portal reachable and describes Board of Revenue Sindh public land-record services including Deh Maps.
HTTP 200; official Maps page links to Deh Maps at /map/Sindh_Map.aspx.
HTTP 200; current JavaScript/configuration inspected. Umer Kot district area routes to Taluka.aspx?district=umer kot; no GIS vector service, schema, or CRS was exposed in the page.
HTTP 200; Umerkot taluka map UI and JavaScript inspected. It calls Taluka.aspx/bindTaluka with zilla_name and taluka_name parameters.

Anonymous JSON POST with zilla_name=umer kot and taluka_name=Umerkot returned a modal stating Available Dehs:0 and no parcel/deh identity or geometry. This route result is inconclusive for citywide absence; parameter/data coverage may be incomplete.
Request timed out after 30 seconds in this environment; no inference about Umerkot deh coverage was made.
Official FAQ reachable in discovery; states records are available for all districts and most Dehs, and describes Village Form II, VII-A, and VII-B limitations. No geometry endpoint was provided.
